activeVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityDescription: Session cookie missing the Partitioned attribute on one legacy endpoint.
activeVulnerabilities.potentialAgencyImpact: Low: cross-site tracking of the session identifier in some browsers.

overdueStatus.explanation: Within the timeframe for an N2 internet-reachable vulnerability.

activeVulnerabilities.supplementaryRiskInformation: The endpoint is scheduled for retirement; the fix ships in release 4.8.

vulnerabilityDetail.vulnerabilityDescription: Image-resizing library flaw with no vendor fix available.
vulnerabilityDetail.potentialAgencyImpact: A malformed image could crash the thumbnail service; no data exposure.
vulnerabilityDetail.supplementaryRiskInformation: A WAF rule rejects images over 20 MB and non-standard headers before they reach the service.

acceptedVulnerabilities.acceptanceRationale: No fix exists upstream; the compensating WAF rule keeps the rating at N1 and the service holds no agency data.
